description: PACKAGE CONTENTS: 1 unit of Groz LED/370 light & a 5V braided USB cable. SUPER BRIGHT: Groz LED/370 comes with bright 6 Watts COB Flash light and 1 Watt top torch. The worklight gives out 600 lumens while the top torch gives out 120 lumens of light. Use the in-built knob to adjust light from 0-600 lumens with ease. SLEEK & SMART DESIGN: Designed to be able to reach even the tightest of spaces with ease because of the slim line design. Comes with a patented 360° swivel & tilt mechanism that allows swivelling of light full 360° as well as tilt adjustment. Additionally, nylon hook with ratcheting mechanism can be rotated full 360° for convenient hanging of light. Magnetic rear end with soft rubber cover to affix light on any metallic surface leaving both hands free and avoid scratches on the metallic surface. WATERPROOF & STURDY: IP54 rating ensures protection against dust and water spray. IK07 Rated ABS body is impact proof and Polycarbonate lens can withstand toughest of job site conditions. RECHARGEABLE: Groz LED/370 light is powered with a 2600 mAh rechargeable battery which can be charged to 100% under 4 hours using the provided Micro-USB cable. The Micro-USB charging port is protected by a rubber bezel.
